notes.title: One Week Left to get Chequered Ink's Greatest Hits on Cassette Tape USB
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for supporting us & helping us to celebrate ten years of making games.

We just wanted to remind you that the Limited Run x Chequered Ink Greatest Hits tape is only on sale for one more week. Pre-orders end on Sunday April 27th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23893909/b980446e1e6debb9346b1dae8d7cf359940aa911.jpg

This collector's item features ten of the best Chequered Ink games from the last decade:


 Innoquous 5: A mind-bending gravity-flipping platformer
 Gyro Boss DX: Dodge an endless assault of wacky weapons from a big, bad boss
 Maddening Euphoria: Escape the wall as you run around in circles
 Cryptrio: Match three madness with a spooky twist
 Revolver and Co: The quiz game where you shoot killer robots with your knowledge
 Plunder Dungeons: The deck-building dungeon crawler with the silliest weapons and outfits
 Ink Cipher: Classic code-breaking to engage your brain
 Spellworm: Feed the hungry worm words & letters to solve puzzles
 Monoquous 2: A physics-defying platformer where everything is black and white
 Non-stop Space Probe: Blast through space as a rocket that never stops


PLUS - 1200 of our fonts with commercial use license for use in your own projects.

We hope you all had a fantastic Easter and we look forward to the next 10 years of sharing our games, fonts and assets with you all!

Get the Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape here.

All the best,

Daniel and Allison

notes.title: Tenth Anniversary: 10 games & 1200 fonts on tape!
notes.content:
Here at Chequered Ink, we’re celebrating our tenth anniversary as an indie game development studio with a cassette tape USB featuring our best games from the last decade - including Innoquous 5!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/23893909/b980446e1e6debb9346b1dae8d7cf359940aa911.jpg

We’ve teamed up with Limited Run Games to create a unique, collectible piece of indie history. Chequered Ink’s Greatest Hits includes the following ten games:


 Innoquous 5: A mind-bending gravity-flipping platformer
 Gyro Boss DX: Dodge an endless assault of wacky weapons from a big, bad boss
 Maddening Euphoria: Escape the wall as you run around in circles
 Cryptrio: Match three madness with a spooky twist
 Revolver and Co: The quiz game where you shoot killer robots with your knowledge
 Plunder Dungeons: The deck-building dungeon crawler with the silliest weapons and outfits
 Ink Cipher: Classic code-breaking to engage your brain
 Spellworm: Feed the hungry worm words & letters to solve puzzles
 Monoquous 2: A physics-defying platformer where everything is black and white
 Non-stop Space Probe: Blast through space as a rocket that never stops


Also included on the tape are all 1200 Chequered Ink Fonts for commercial use. Bring your designs to life with fonts in every kind of style, from scribbly handwriting to graceful calligraphy and everything in between!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/23893909/8cf8e6a6e201f9d7d1e57fc49708de193c0c75dd.jpg

The Greatest Hits USB Tape is available on pre-order from March 25th to April 27th, 2025 for $29.99 – which represents a HUGE saving versus the cost of buying all of our games and fonts individually, plus you get a cool retro trinket for your video game collection. What’s not to like?

As a Limited Run release, this is the ONLY time you’ll be able to get your hands on the Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape. Check it out on the Limited Run Games website here:

Chequered Ink Greatest Hits Tape

notes.title: Nov 9th 2017 Innoquous 5 patch
notes.content:
A minor patch has just gone out for Innoquous 5. This changes the following levels/requirements to make them possible:

- Level 87 Bunny Hunt - added a missing route
- Level 9 Time Attack - can now be gold medalled
- Level 10 Time Attack - can now be gold medalled
- Level 35 Time Attack - can now be gold medalled

Thank you very much to omeghamatt http://steamcommunity.com/id/gnojak/stats/453830/achievements/ for their help in ensuring that the game is now 100%able, including all 175 gold medals.
